decisions.reason: GA4 remains the mandatory analytics standard. The plugin supports the firm's analytics and conversion bundle at low upkeep, so its results meet the aspiration and give no cause for problemistic search.

The retail interface plugin draws on core integration skills and supports shop projects. Its niche results are still uncertain, but carrying it costs little and the firm's slack in a growing industry allows it to mature.
Relaunch SEO support is tied to the firm's core relaunch business and is a labor-based service with little fixed cost. It still has its own page, which signals results at or above aspiration.
The SEO workshops are newly launched with their own page and use existing marketing expertise at low cost. Slack lets the firm wait for evidence before judging them against its aspiration.
